An older woman with an oval face, straight bangs, thin arched eyebrows, and medium-thin lips. She is wearing a textured white flat cap with a dark band.

Older adult with an oval face, soft cheek and jawline fullness, and straight bangs under a textured white flat cap with a dark band. Features include thin, sparse arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes with visible creases, a straight nasal dorsum with a rounded tip, medium-thin lips with a defined cupid's bow, and mild vertical neck creases.

This is an older woman with an oval face shape and straight bangs. She has thin eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes, and medium-thin lips. She is wearing a textured white flat cap that has a dark band on it.
